english:
Monday. Tone Plagal 4th [դկ - Dk]. Of the Saints: Epiphanius of Cyprus, Babylas the Patriarch, and his three disciples.
In the Morning, Hymn of the Martyrs [ահ. Մարտիրոսաց].
Patristic Canticle, Tone 4th [դձ - Dz]: "Who worked wonders" (Սքանչելագործ) with its canons.
Children's [Մկք. - Mankunk] and Evening [Հմբ. - Hambartsi] Hymn, Tone 3rd [գձ - Gd]: "Likened unto Moses" (Նմանեալ մովսիսի).
Midday Liturgy Introit: "The Patriarchal" (Զհայրապետականն).
Patristic Hymn, Tone 4th [դձ - Dz]: "Today the Heavenly" (Այսօր երկնայնոցն).
Psalm 131 [132]: "Let Your priests".
Proverbs of Wisdom 8:7: "If [anyone loves] righteousness" to verse 10: "honor rather than age".
Prophet Nahum 1:7: "The Lord is good" to verse 9: "in trouble".
Epistle, 1 Corinthians 12:4: "Now there are diversities" to verse 11: "as He wills".
Alleluia: "Let Your priests".
Gospel, Mark 6:45: "And immediately" to verse 52: "their heart was hardened".

Tuesday. Tone 3rd [գձ - Gd]. Of the Holy Saints: Constantine the King and his mother Helena.
In the Morning, Hymn, Tone 1st [ակ - Ak]: "Who the Heavenly" (Որ զերկնաւոր).
Patristic Canticle, Tone 1st [ած - Ad]: "We bless You" (Օրհնեմք զքեզ) with its canons.
Magnificat [Մեծ. - Metsatsustse], "Blessed" (Երանելի).
Children's [Մկք.] and Evening [Հմբ.] Hymn, Tone Plagal 3rd [գկ - Gk]: "O Blessed One" (Ով երանելիդ).
Midday Liturgy Introit: "As after the God-loving".
Psalm 20 [21]: "The King shall joy in Your strength, O Lord".
Proverbs 16:9: "A man's heart" to verse 17: "righteousness".
Prophet Jeremiah (Baruch) 3:31: "There is none that knows" to 4:4: "are known to us".
Epistle, 1 Timothy 2:1: "I exhort therefore" to verse 7: "in truth".
Alleluia: "The King shall joy in Your strength".
Gospel, Luke 7:1: "Now when he had ended" to verse 10: "found the servant whole that had been sick".

Wednesday. Tone 1st [ակ - Ak].
Patristic Canticle, Tone 1st [ած - Ad]: "Who in all" (Որ յամենայնի).
Midday Liturgy Psalm 65 [66]: "Save Your servant".
Epistle, Romans 7:1: "Know you not" to verse 11: "by it slew me".
Alleluia: "O Lord, rebuke me not in Your anger".
Gospel, Matthew 12:9: "And when he was departed" to verse 15: "he withdrew from thence".

Thursday. Tone 2nd [բձ - Bd]. Of the Holy Saints: Theodotion of Galatia, Thalelaeus the Physician, and the Seven Virgins who were martyred in Ancyra.
Patristic Canticle, Tone 1st [ակ - Ak]: "Holy God".
Midday Liturgy Psalm 115 [116]: "Precious in the sight".
Proverbs of Wisdom 6:11: "For they that have kept" to verse 21: "into the kingdom".
Epistle, 2 Corinthians 6:1: "We then, as workers together" to verse 10: "possessing all things".
Alleluia: "Let the saints be joyful".
Gospel, John 16:1: "These things have I spoken" to verse 5: "I was with you".

Friday. Tone Plagal 2nd [բկ - Bk].
Canticle of Rest [Հանգ.], Tone Plagal 2nd [բկ - Bk]: "Creator and Lover of mankind".
Midday Liturgy Psalm 97 [98]: "All the ends of the earth".
Epistle, Romans 7:12: "Wherefore the law is holy" to verse 25: "our Lord".
Alleluia: "Return, O Lord".
Gospel, Matthew 12:15: "And they went out" to verse 21: "shall trust".

Saturday. Tone 3rd [գձ - Gd]. Feast of Saint Gregory our Enlightener: Discovery of his Relics.
At the Evening Service, Pre-festive [նախատօնակ - Nakhatonak] Hymn, Tone Plagal 3rd [գկ - Gk]: "All the mountains" (Լերինք ամենայն).
Patristic Canticle, Tone 2nd [բձ - Bd]: "Who sent Your beloved" (Որ առաքեցեր զսիրելի) with its canons.
And at Night:
In the Morning, Hymn, Tone Plagal 3rd [գկ - Gk]: "All the mountains" (Լերինք ամենայն).
"King forever": "Today the ranks".
Patristic Canticle, Tone 2nd [բձ - Bd]: "Who sent" with its canons.
Children's [Մկք.], Tone 4th [դձ - Dz]: "Wondrous" (Հրաշափառ) and "Who were called" (Որ կոչեցար).
Midday Liturgy Introit: "Let us rejoice today".
Patristic Hymn, Tone Plagal 3rd [գկ - Gk]: "Good Shepherd" (Հովիւ քաջ).
Psalm 131 [132]: "Let Your priests".
Proverbs of Wisdom 4:7: "But though the righteous" to verse 15: "His chosen".
Prophet Micah 7:7: "Therefore I will look unto the Lord" to verse 10: "shall behold her".
Acts 20:22: "And now, behold" to verse 32: "all".
Alleluia: "You are a priest".
Gospel, John 10:11: "I am the good shepherd" to verse 16: "and one shepherd".
In the Evening: "Joyous Light" (Լոյս զուարթ).
Messedi [Մեսե.]: "I love, because the Lord has heard". "In the exit".
Evening [Հմբ.], Tone 1st [ած - Ad]: "Holy art You, O Lord".
Proclamation [Քարոզ]: "Let us ask" (Խնդրեսցուք). "Save us" (Կեցո).
Prayer: "King of peace" (Թագաւոր խաղաղութեան).

Fourth Sunday after Pentecost. Tone Plagal 3rd [գկ - Gk].
Patristic Canticle, Tone 1st [ակ - Ak]: "Who came for salvation" (Որ եկիր ի փրկութիւն).
Magnificat, Tone 1st [ակ - Ak]: "Who made life immortal" (Որ զկեանքն անմահարար).
Midday Liturgy Psalm 64 [65]: "Praise is due to You".
Prophet Isaiah 1:21: "How is the faithful city" to verse 31: "none shall quench them".
Psalm: "Sing a psalm".
Epistle, Romans 7:25: "So then" to 8:11: "by His Spirit that dwells in you".
Alleluia: "Come and see".
Gospel, Matthew 12:38: "Then certain of the scribes" to verse 45: "unto this wicked generation".
In the Evening, Messedi: "Our God is in heaven". "In the exit".
Evening [Հմբ.], Tone Plagal 3rd [գկ - Gk]: "Resurrection" (Յարութեան).
